blocks.text: ATLANTA, Georgia — An autonomous Uber car is seen making its way towards a hotel in the Beltline area here in what passengers said was an “aggressive but careful” ride. An artificial intelligence expert and educator from the South Caucasus region, who is in the United States for a professional exchange program, said they paid $12 for the 3.3-kilometer ride, and was trying the driverless car service for the first time. His fellow passengers called the autonomous car’s driving aggressive but careful, as it tried to immediately go as fast as other cars, but would halt as humans cross the streets. […]...
